subject: Reminder on updated workshop outline
text:
Good morning,

Just a gentle reminder that the updated workshop outline is due back by end of day today, so we can lock the room schedule before the client review tomorrow. If the budget section still needs numbers from us, I can send a short summary quickly. Please let me know whether the draft is nearly ready, and if any detail is holding it up. I appreciate you squeezing this in. There is no need to reply fully, just a quick status note would help.
